step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Ounass's machine learning-based recommendation system pipeline built on AWS. The system is split into two major workflows: a scheduled batch training and deployment workflow managed by AWS Step Functions, and a real-time recommendation inference flow for web clients. In the automated pipeline (Flow 0), EventBridge triggers a Step Functions State Machine periodically. The State Machine coordinates three stages: 1) triggering a Data Processing Lambda that queries user browsing history via Athena, storing query results into Amazon S3; 2) launching a SageMaker training job running BlazingText (word2vec) reading from S3 to generate product item vectors; 3) deploying/updating a SageMaker real-time endpoint with the updated model. In the real-time serving workflow (Flow 1), a Web Client browsing product pages triggers an API request through API Gateway to a Serving Lambda function, which queries the deployed SageMaker endpoint to return similar recommended items based on vector distance back to the user interface.

graph.name: Ounass Machine Learning Recommendation System Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture powers real-time product recommendations for the Ounass luxury e-commerce platform using SageMaker BlazingText (word2vec) trained on browsing history, orchestrated periodically by Step Functions and EventBridge, yielding a 0.6% conversion rate increase.

nodes.name: EVENT BRIDGE
nodes.notes: Periodically triggers the state machine workflow based on a scheduled rule.

nodes.name: STATE MACHINE
nodes.notes: Orchestrates the multi-stage machine learning workflow (data fetching, training, endpoint deployment).

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Data Processing)
nodes.notes: First step in state machine workflow; invokes Athena to perform data lake querying.

nodes.name: ATHENA
nodes.notes: Queries user browsing history datasets stored in the data lake.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores processed training datasets exported from Athena and trained model artifacts.

nodes.name: SAGEMAKER (Training)
nodes.notes: Runs BlazingText (word2vec) training job to convert browsing history into product vector representations.

nodes.name: SAGEMAKER (Endpoint)
nodes.notes: Hosts the real-time SageMaker model endpoint for serving item recommendations.

nodes.name: LAMBDA (Serving)
nodes.notes: Invoked by API Gateway to call the SageMaker endpoint with product IDs and fetch recommendations.

nodes.name: API GATEWAY
nodes.notes: Exposes recommendation API endpoints and routes requests from frontend web clients.

nodes.name: Web Client
nodes.notes: Ounass e-commerce web platform where users browse products and view recommendations.

edges.notes: EventBridge rule triggers the State Machine workflow on a periodic schedule.
State Machine invokes the Data Processing Lambda function.
Data Processing Lambda executes query against Athena.
Athena writes query results (browsing history dataset) into S3.
State Machine triggers SageMaker model training job upon data preparation completion.
SageMaker reads training dataset from and writes trained model vectors to S3.
State Machine triggers deployment/update of SageMaker real-time endpoint.
SageMaker training outputs update configuration for the SageMaker endpoint.
Web Client sends request with product ID to API Gateway when user views a product.
API Gateway routes recommendation request to the serving Lambda.
Serving Lambda queries SageMaker real-time endpoint with product ID to get similar product recommendations.
